source: Mixed precision remains essential. Current Transformer Engine documentation states that linear operations can run in low precision while normalization, softmax, and other operations remain at higher precision by default; attention precision also depends on recipe/backend configuration.
zh: 混合精度仍然至关重要。当前的 Transformer Engine 文档指出，线性运算可以低精度运行，而归一化、softmax 和其他运算默认保持较高精度；注意力精度还取决于配方/后端配置。
